entry.recoupedSource: Low confidence: BroadwayWorld forum thread "& JULIET Recoups Its Investment" (June 11, 2024), where posters list Plaza Suite among plays that recouped ("SWEENEY, MUSIC MAN, PLAZA SUITE, and WOODS definitely recouped"). entry.capitalizationSource: Estimate: $2,000,887 NYC theatrical tax credit to Suite 719 LLC (the Plaza Suite production company) at the 25% credit rate implies about $8.0M of production cost.
entry.notes: Limited-run revival of Neil Simon's comedy at the Hudson Theatre (opened Mar 28, 2022; closed Jul 10, 2022) starring Sarah Jessica Parker and Matthew Broderick; broke the Hudson's house record several times. Recoupment rests on a fan forum report, not a producer or trade announcement, so this verdict is low confidence.
